detail_desc: Top in lightweight sweatshirt fabric with dropped shoulders, and ribbing around the neckline, cuffs and hem.
Suit trousers in a stretch weave with a regular waist, concealed hook-and-eye fastening and zip fly. Side pockets and tapered legs with creases.
Sleeveless playsuit in soft, patterned cotton jersey with a raw-edge, flounced trim at the top and small opening with a button at the back of the neck. Elasticated seam at the waist and short legs.
Short dress in soft jersey with a V-neck, narrow, adjustable shoulder straps, seam at the waist and flared skirt.
Bracelets in various designs. Two are made of waxed cotton cord, one decorated with metal beads. The other two are made of elastic with wooden beads, one decorated with metal beads.

Cropped top in soft, patterned jersey with a smocked bodice and square neckline with covered elastication at the top. Long, wide sleeves with narrow, covered elastication at the cuffs, and a seam and small flounce at the hem. Unlined.
Wide trousers in a soft viscose weave with a high, elasticated paper bag waist, sewn-in tie belt, side pockets and straight, wide legs.
Long-sleeved tops in soft jersey with a round neckline, button placket and short slits in the sides. The cotton content of the tops is organic.
Sandals in imitation suede with hook and loop fastenings. Imitation suede linings and insoles, and fluted soles.
Fully lined bikini bottoms with a low waist and narrow sides with decorative gathers and rings.
Calf-length dress in a softly draping viscose weave with a grandad collar and covered buttons down the front. Long raglan sleeves with buttoned cuffs, and a detachable tie belt at the waist.

Handbag accessory with a metal keyring and carabiner hook, and an imitation leather pendant in the shape of a backpack. The backpack has a zip at the top, imitation leather tassel and a small, zipped outer compartment. Size approx. 4x11.5x15 cm.

Microfibre body with a gently sculpting effect on the waist, hips, back and seat. Non-wired, mesh-lined lace cups with removable inserts that give the bust a natural shape and light support. Narrow adjustable shoulder straps and glued hems for a smooth silhouette. Lined gusset with press-studs.
Jumper in textured-knit cotton with a round neck, long puff sleeves and ribbing around the neckline, cuffs and hem.
Trunks in stretch cotton jersey with flatlock seams, short legs, an elasticated waist and a lined front.
Short, sleeveless dress in sturdy jersey with a low-cut back, seam at the waist and flared skirt. The polyester content of the dress is partly recycled.

Blouse in a patterned, lightly crêped viscose weave with a round neckline and small opening with a covered button at the back of the neck. Short sleeves with a small opening with ties at the hems and gathers at the shoulders.
Set with a long-sleeved dress and pair of leggings in soft, organic cotton jersey. Dress with a round neckline and gathered seam at the top. Leggings with covered elastication at the waist.
Short-sleeved playsuit in jersey crêpe with a V-neck and sewn-in wrapover with gentle draping at the top. Narrow, elasticated seam and a sewn-in tie belt at the waist, and diagonal side pockets.
T-shirt in soft cotton jersey with a print motif.
